description_en: Revokes permissions on databases and database accounts from a user group
description_zh: 移除给用户组授权的数据库及数据库账户
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost detach-database-accounts-from-user-group --instance-id bastionhost-cn-7mz2v120f0y --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --user-group-id 1 --databases '[{"DatabaseId":"4","DatabaseAccountIds":["1"]}]' --region cn-hangzhou
name: DetachDatabaseAccountsFromUserGroup

parameters.help_en:
The bastion host ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the bastion host ID
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机实例的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的区域ID。
区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the user group from which you want to revoke permissions on databases and database accounts.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204509.html operation to query the ID of the user group
parameters.help_zh:
指定要移除授权数据库和数据库账户的用户组ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204509.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: user_group_id

fields.help_en: The ID of the database on which the permissions are to be revoked
fields.help_zh: 指定要移除授权的数据库实例ID
fields.name: database_id

fields.help_en: An array that consists of database account IDs
fields.help_zh: 要移除授权的数据库账户ID
fields.name: database_account_ids

parameters.help_zh: 要移除授权的数据库信息
parameters.name: databases
